title: Pullback compatibility on scalar-computed cochain representatives
statement:
theorem section_pull_transport_condition_on_computed (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (normalized : PullNormalized a f lam)
    (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ' f ≅
      ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T)
    (hnorm : SectionPullNormalized a f cX cY barLam)
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules Λ Y) ℤ)
    [IsIso ((scalarCounit a Y).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))] :
    (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedFunctor Λ' X).map
        (lam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        cX.derived.hom.app ((L Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        cX.model.T.map ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullComparison Λ f).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) =
      (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullComparison Λ' f).hom.app
          ((D a Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ' f).map
          (cY.derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        barLam.hom.app ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedFunctor Λ Y).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))

source.place: Tags 06YY, 0D6D and 07A6; computation and pasting step of the parent transport argument.

proof.text: Use the proved scalar and geometric computation lemmas for the four sides of the diagram. Lift the ordinary square termwise and convert PullNormalized from homotopy to cochain computations.

The scalar counit at P is invertible by hypothesis. Its scalar computation equation implies that the section scalar counit on the section image of P is invertible. The section pullback localization counit is also invertible. Postcompose the desired comparison equality with the resulting computation composite. Naturality, the ordinary square, the internal square and the section normalization identify the two composites, which can then be cancelled. All categorical pasting and cancellation are proved in private generic helpers.

proof_origin.place: The scalar-computed representative step, split only to keep each proved module within the compilation limit.
